caption.text:
Aksi penolakan terhadap LGBT kembali menjadi sorotan. Kali ini, sejumlah warga di Bogor menggelar gerakan yang mereka sebut “Bogor Bersih LGBT”.

Dalam video yang beredar di media sosial, terlihat sejumlah warga mendatangi, merekam, dan meminta individu yang diduga LGBT meninggalkan lokasi. Pihak penyelenggara mengklaim aksi dilakukan tanpa kekerasan dan hanya berupa penertiban langsung di lapangan.

Aksi tersebut pun memicu beragam respons dari warganet. Bagaimana menurut kalian?

#okezone  #Bogor #bogorbersihlgbt
caption.text_translation:
Denial action against LGBTQ is back in the spotlight. This time, a number of citizens in Bogor called the movement they call "Bogor Clean LGBT".

In a video circulating on social media, a number of citizens can be seen coming, recording, and asking suspected LGBT individuals to leave the location. The organizers claim that the action was done without violence and was only direct regulation on the field.

The action also provoked various responses from the citizens. What do you guys think?

 #okezone #Bogor #bogorbersihlgbt
